minimalgearhud.configuration.title: %s Settings
minimalgearhud.configuration.enabled.too: Master switch for the widget and warnings. Can also be toggled in game with a key.
ALWAYS: all items with durability. DAMAGED_ONLY: only damaged ones. WARNINGS_ONLY: only items that need attention.
minimalgearhud.configuration.hideInScree: Hide the widget while a menu or inventory is open. Chat keeps it visible.
minimalgearhud.configuration.showArmor.t: Show worn armor pieces that have durability.
minimalgearhud.configuration.showMainHan: Show the main-hand item if it has durability.
minimalgearhud.configuration.showOffHand: Show the off-hand item if it has durability (shield, tools).
minimalgearhud.configuration.showUsesEst: Show an approximate number of remaining uses (~N) for held items. Takes Unbreaking into account.
minimalgearhud.configuration.showMending: Show a small green + on items that have Mending.
minimalgearhud.configuration.layout.tool: Where and how big the widget is.
minimalgearhud.configuration.anchor.tool: Which part of the screen the widget is attached to.
minimalgearhud.configuration.offsetX.too: Extra horizontal shift in GUI pixels (positive = right).
minimalgearhud.configuration.offsetY.too: Extra vertical shift in GUI pixels (positive = down).
minimalgearhud.configuration.backgroundO: Opacity of the dark panel behind the widget (0 = none).
minimalgearhud.configuration.showBar.too: Draw a thin colored bar under the text.
minimalgearhud.configuration.colorScheme: CLASSIC (green to red), COLORBLIND (blue to orange) or MONOCHROME.
minimalgearhud.configuration.warningEnab: Pulse a warning when an item is about to break.
Below this durability percentage a soft warning starts.
minimalgearhud.configuration.criticalPer: Below this percentage the warning becomes urgent. An item that breaks on its next use is always urgent.
minimalgearhud.configuration.warnOffHand: Also warn about the off-hand item.
minimalgearhud.configuration.vignette.to: Pulse a soft glow along the screen edges.
minimalgearhud.configuration.vignetteStr: Maximum brightness of the screen-edge glow.
minimalgearhud.configuration.reducedMoti: Show a steady glow instead of a pulsing one (helps if flashing bothers you).
minimalgearhud.configuration.sound.toolt: Play a short sound when an item enters the warning state.
minimalgearhud.configuration.soundCooldo: Minimum seconds between two warning sounds.
